verdict.rationale: OpenHands ships explicit automation for bug diagnosis and fixing: watching for new bugs/incidents and gathering logs (openhands-docs-7), detecting failed workflows/inspecting logs/identifying cause and opening a PR fix (openhands-docs-9), and general natural-language task execution via CLI (openhands-docs-1). This directly matches autonomous bug diagnosis-and-fix, though missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of fix success rate and end-to-end case studies beyond vendor docs.
